Tooltip_DazedDownspout: Bolt it to the outside of a building's wall. While it rains it takes its share of the whole roof (up to 80 L/h) and holds a little; pipe it to a water tank, or stand it beside one. Rainwater is clean. More downspouts on a big roof catch more.
Tooltip_DazedPipeSection: One square of pipe. Lay a run from a machine's or tank's menu (Welding 1 and a pipe wrench); one section per square laid or mended.
Tooltip_DazedPlumb_NeedPatchParts: A patch needs a small sheet of metal and screws.
Tooltip_DazedPlumb_NoVessel_Gas: You are carrying no petrol can with petrol in it.
Tooltip_DazedPlumb_NoVessel_Propane: You are carrying no propane tank or lantern bottle with propane in it.
Tooltip_DazedPlumb_NoVessel_Water: You are carrying nothing with water in it.
Tooltip_DazedPumpElectric: Draws water from the ground on bare grass or dirt, by itself while the square has power. Pipe it to a water tank. The ground can run dry, and refills slowly (faster in rain).
Tooltip_DazedPumpHand: Draws water from the ground on bare grass or dirt. Pipe it to a water tank and work the handle, or fill containers from it. The ground can run dry, and refills slowly (faster in rain).
Tooltip_DazedPurifier: Cleans tainted water. Pipe a pump into it, then pipe it on to a water tank. Needs power. Slow without a filter cartridge.
Tooltip_DazedPurifierFilter: A filter cartridge for the water purifier. Treats about 500 litres. Its condition is how much is left.
Tooltip_DazedSprinkler: Pipe it to a water tank and it waters the crops within 3 squares whenever they are thirsty, never more than they want. Up to 10 L a minute. Switch it off, set its watering hours or let it skip rainy spells from its menu.
Tooltip_DazedTankGas: A steel fuel tank for petrol. Pour in from petrol cans and out again. Leaks when hurt, and the fumes catch fire.
Tooltip_DazedTankPropane: A steel propane tank. Fill it from propane cylinders and lantern bottles; take it back out the same way. Leaks and burns when hurt.
Tooltip_DazedTankWater: A steel water tank. Pour in and out by hand. Leaks when hurt.
Tooltip_DazedValve: A shut-off valve. Fit it on any sound pipe square from the pipe's menu (Welding 2 and a pipe wrench), then open or close it by hand.
Tooltip_DazedWaterMain: Stands outdoors beside a house. Pipe it to a water tank, then right-click it to choose the building: every sink, bath, shower, toilet and washer inside is fed from the tank once the town water is off, up to the line rate for the whole house. A fixture with a tap of its own keeps its tap.
Tooltip_DazedPlumb_MainClear: Disconnect the building this main serves.
Tooltip_DazedFuelPumpHand: Pipe it to a petrol tank, then crank it to refuel a parked vehicle within 2 squares or to fill a petrol can. Slow (2 L a minute), needs no power.
Tooltip_DazedFuelPumpElectric: Pipe it to a petrol tank and wire it to a Dazed Power controller (200 W while pumping). Refuels a parked vehicle within 2 squares or fills a petrol can at about 10 L a minute. It does not run off the grid or a generator's square.
Tooltip_DazedDigester: Feed it rotten food and manure by hand (right-click -> Add waste). Over a day or so each unit makes about 0.05 kg of propane, which flows into a propane tank you pipe it to. Needs no power. Slows below 10 C, stops below 0 C, and holds up to 2 kg of gas when the tank is full.
Tooltip_DazedDrilledWell: Set it on bare ground in the open, pipe it to a water tank and wire it to a Dazed Power controller (400 W while pumping). It lifts about 15 L of clean water a minute from deep ground until the tank is full. It does not run off the grid or a generator's square.
Tooltip_DazedSmoker: Pipe it to a propane tank, put raw meat or fish inside and light it. It burns about 0.05 kg of propane an hour; after 8 hours of smoke the meat is smoked: cooked, and keeping six times longer. It goes out when the gas runs out.
